title: A perfect private retreat, 5 minutes from Anyang Station
description: ILLOWA is the only hotel in the area pairing high-spec gaming suites with a 100+ noodle snack bar — at rates well below Seoul.
Every room includes free OTT streaming, high-speed PCs, and access to a free snack bar with over 100 noodle options.
From business travelers to couples seeking a city getaway, we offer a comfortable and memorable stay.
